headline.text: Management wording (confident vs cautious cues, -1..+1): prepared +1.00, qa +0.67

tone.method: lexical cue counts on management sentences; indicative of wording, not a measure of business health

signals.speaker: Stephen Hemsley
signals.sentence: At Optum, we're seeing building momentum from Optum Health as the business re-centers back to its integrated value-based care delivery model.

signals.speaker: Stephen Hemsley
signals.sentence: Optum Rx continues to perform to plan as transparency initiatives we announced early this year resonate well in the marketplace.

signals.speaker: Stephen Hemsley
signals.sentence: Optum Insight, also on plan, remains on a multi-year path of reinvestment and innovation as we bring modern intelligent technologies and services to the areas of greatest need in the health system.

signals.speaker: Stephen Hemsley
signals.sentence: Our operating structure today broadly reflects a set of highly regulated benefit businesses and a complementary set of products and services for patients, care providers, and customers.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: As you have seen, UnitedHealthcare's overall performance in the second quarter exceeded expectations, driven by better results in Medicare Advantage, while commercial benefits remain pressured.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: We now expect full-year Medicare Advantage enrollment to decline by approximately 1.1 million and Medicare margins to finish 2026 above 3%.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: Looking to our 2027 bids, our benefit planning remains disciplined and grounded in the current trend environment.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: We will continue to support program and margin stability through actions including benefit adjustments and selective changes in market participation.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: Our focus is on closing the gap between lagging reimbursement rates and underlying medical cost trends while continuing to partner closely with states to support the long-term sustainability of Medicaid benefits and support them in identifying and reducing fraud, waste, and abuse.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: The primary drivers of pressure are the independent resolution process under the No Surprises Act, which applies only to commercial plans, and more aggressive billing practices among providers, especially higher service and coding intensity and higher cost per encounter that result from the more fee-for-service orientation of commercial plans.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: Returning to UnitedHealthcare as a whole, we are confident in being able to deliver meaningful earnings growth in 2026 and into 2027 with the reinvestments we are making in the business to build a stronger, more durable foundation for 2027 and beyond.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: For example, in the quarter, we committed to eliminating, by the end of this year, 30% of prior authorization volume and nearly two-thirds of prior authorization requirements for pediatric care.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: We continue to take concrete steps to reduce complexity and increase speed by further simplifying prior authorization, increasing consumer-responsive digital experiences, providing greater support to rural hospitals and care providers, offering more consumer-centered product innovation, and much more.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: We're confident these efforts will bolster UnitedHealthcare's long-term performance and market position.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: As Steve noted, we are seeing positive momentum across Optum, with all three business segments performing in line or ahead of plan through the first half of the year.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: We are steadfast in our intent to optimize an integrated value-based care system that benefits patients, care providers, and taxpayers.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: Third, in rural health, we've expanded access to care by integrating house calls and home-based care capabilities coupled with treat-in-place offerings for patients with complex chronic and behavioral health conditions.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: This gives us greater and more timely visibility into performance, driving consistent, best-in-class standards across the portfolio, and deploying technologies to support clinicians in the important work they do.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: There is real progress on the rollout of AI-based ambient listening capabilities, available to 70% of our employed providers today and on track to exceed 90% by year-end.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: Optum Health will build upon this foundation with additional investments in clinical workflow improvements and network performance, more deeply embedding AI and automation to further improve operational performance and clinician experience.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: Additionally, we entered the 2027 benefit planning season very differently than years past, starting with much earlier proactive collaboration with all our payer partners.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: As our plans and initiatives begin to mature and scale, with disciplined execution, we expect margins to continue to steadily improve.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: In May, we announced a new pharmacy care approach based on monthly per-member fees with full PBM and GPO fee transparency and enhanced consumer tools.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: Client feedback has been positive and focused on how greater transparency and clinical alignment can address trend challenges, shifting the conversation to affordable health outcomes versus economic guarantees.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: This all builds on our industry-leading commitment last year to pass through 100% of manufacturer rebates to customers by the end of 2027.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: AI-enabled approaches continue to gain traction as more payer and provider customers seek differentiated capabilities to drive better performance.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: For example, Value Connect is an AI-driven insights platform integrated into provider workflows and electronic health records to improve value-based care performance.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: Bringing this all together, halfway through the year, we have made steady progress in each of our Optum businesses and will continue to find ways to better serve patients, providers, and customers.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: Total revenues were $112 billion, largely consistent with the prior year, while operating earnings of $8 billion grew 55% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: The operating cost ratio was 12.7% for the quarter, compared to 12.3% a year ago, as we continue to focus on operating discipline while making targeted investments across technology, AI, care delivery enhancements, customer experience, and advancing healthier communities through the United Health Foundation.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: Operating cash flows in the quarter were approximately $11 billion, or 1.9 times net income, reflecting timing of substantial government payments and strong earnings.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: This provides capital to strengthen the balance sheet, invest in growth, and return value to shareholders.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: Through mid-July, we have deployed $4 billion for repurchases of 11.4 million shares.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: We now expect to complete total share repurchases of at least $5 billion in 2026, compared to initial guidance of $2.5 billion.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: During the quarter, we returned $2.1 billion to shareholders through our dividend, which our board increased to $9.28 per share on an annualized basis.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: Lastly, on July 2nd, we successfully closed the previously announced combination with Alegeus.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: We continue to be respectful of medical trend, and we believe this refreshed outlook appropriately balances risk and investments with durable run rate earnings.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: We're providing new adjusted earnings per share guidance range of $19.50 to $20, with slightly more earnings in 3Q relative to 4Q. We are increasing the full-year operating earnings outlook for UnitedHealthcare to at least $12 billion and for Optum Health to at least $2.2 billion.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: We expect the operating cost ratio to come in at the higher end of our previously discussed range as a result of investments in our people, communities, and AI.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: The overall earnings cadence for the year remains consistent with prior expectations.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: Similarly, we expect nearly all of Optum Health's earnings to be recognized in the first half, with modest profit in Q3, offset by modest losses in the fourth quarter due to the seasonality of the risk-based businesses.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: In contrast, Optum Insight and Optum Rx remain more heavily weighted towards the second half of the year, with each expected to generate approximately 55% of their full-year earnings during the back half as client implementations, growth investments, and normal business seasonality progress through the year.

signals.speaker: Stephen Hemsley
signals.sentence: Our press release this morning has a sampling of these initiatives.

signals.speaker: Stephen Hemsley
signals.sentence: As the U.S. health system continues to evolve, we will evolve our approaches and our businesses as a scaled and diverse enterprise, driving integrated value-based care anchored in the first principles of the right care at the right time and in the right setting.

signals.speaker: Stephen Hemsley
signals.sentence: Artificial intelligence technologies applied in practical ways that help people can be an accelerator to achieving that goal as we use them to literally reimagine our enterprise.

signals.speaker: Stephen Hemsley
signals.sentence: You should expect us to continue along that path and pick up momentum as we better fulfill our mission with accountability to you and all stakeholders in the health system.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: Trend remains elevated versus pre-pandemic levels, but stable with continued pressure in specialty pharmacy, home and community-based services, and behavioral healthcare services.

signals.speaker: Dan Kueter
signals.sentence: We came into 2026 planning for margin expansion, and simply put, we're not yielding the full margin expansion for which we'd planned in 2026.

signals.speaker: Dan Kueter
signals.sentence: I see 2026 as a delay to that margin recovery trajectory, not a setback.

signals.speaker: Dan Kueter
signals.sentence: We remain confident that that journey will result in a return to our historic margin performance of 7% or greater for the commercial group business.

signals.speaker: Stephen Hemsley
signals.sentence: If you take a look at this business approach and the challenges in the healthcare system, I think that we can grow in that range, particularly recognizing that it includes productivity gains and use of capital.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: However, it has no financial impact inside of the quarter or the full year because we've made the pledge to return our profits to consumers for 2026.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: For now, the bottom line is trend is a little lower than our planning expectations in Medicare, and we feel good about our ability to influence and manage that through benefit planning and other initiatives.

signals.speaker: Bobby
signals.sentence: Importantly, the improvement is also the result of targeted actions we've taken through benefit design, product positioning resulting in a more favorable membership mix, network curation focused on high-quality, low-cost providers, broad affordability initiatives, and continued investment in aligned provider models like value-based care.

signals.speaker: Bobby
signals.sentence: Overall, I feel good about our assumptions for 2026 and remain intensely focused on affordability given the still elevated levels of medical trend versus the historical baseline.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: As Steve commented on the 13%-16% growth algorithm, we personally have never deviated from that view, and we believe that is the right starting point as you think about our stepping-off point.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: Similar to the prior period development, while that benefited us in one direction, we continue to invest in our foundation, which some might view as one-time.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: We are now up to $1 billion in the foundation, which is an important part of our commitment to our communities.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: That being said, Lisa, we have a number of positive momentum items, and the durability of the underlying run rate is strong, as you can see in our cash flows.

signals.speaker: Dan Kueter
signals.sentence: It has existed for some time, and it continues to accelerate in the volume of disputes, which highlights the deficiencies of the IDR process.

signals.speaker: Dan Kueter
signals.sentence: As volume has increased, this creates cost and delay for all involved.

signals.speaker: Dan Kueter
signals.sentence: These numbers have accelerated.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: The bottom line is we're seeing trend a little lower than planning expectations in Medicare, and we feel good about our ability to influence that through benefit planning and other measures.

signals.speaker: Krista
signals.sentence: Key drivers include improved medical performance from care management and clinical management initiatives we launched in the West and have scaled and expanded to other regions.

signals.speaker: Krista
signals.sentence: We had much earlier collaboration for 2027 benefit planning, so we're aligned on footprint, rates, and benefit designs.

signals.speaker: Krista
signals.sentence: Inside the ASC business, earnings are growing in line with expectations, volumes are in line, and physician recruitment, provider productivity, and service mix are all in line to slightly better than expected.

signals.speaker: Sandeep
signals.sentence: Q2 performance was driven by strong operational execution, some of which was due to early AI investments that delivered efficiency gains.

signals.speaker: Sandeep
signals.sentence: Also, some client transaction volume moved earlier into the year from the second half to the first half, more than we expected.

signals.speaker: Sandeep
signals.sentence: We continue to invest in new AI products and services in the back half of this year where we see early positive customer momentum.

signals.speaker: Sandeep
signals.sentence: The combination leaves us confident in our full year guidance.

signals.speaker: Sandeep
signals.sentence: Optum Insight remains on a multi-year path of reinvestment and innovation.

signals.speaker: Stephen Hemsley
signals.sentence: It's occurring across the spectrum of our businesses and will have compounding effects as we make investments.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: Deployment of AI and other advanced technologies is a critical focus across UnitedHealthcare and a big enabler of our modernization agenda.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: Third, AI facilitates interoperability with health systems and care providers, enabling real-time information sharing and our commitment to process 80% of prior authorizations in real time by the end of 2027.

signals.speaker: Tim Noel
signals.sentence: We will invest some savings in enhanced, more concierge service models while maintaining options for human interactions.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: Digital prior authorization powered by AI has produced 96% first-pass approval while enabling human review when something isn't approved.

signals.speaker: Patrick Conway
signals.sentence: In clinical support, ambient clinical documentation has been rolled out to 70% of employed Optum Health clinicians, on track to exceed 90% by year-end, and reduces cognitive burnout significantly for clinicians.

signals.speaker: Sandeep
signals.sentence: One quick example that connects these points: about a third of our investments this year are going into commercializing internal use cases.

signals.speaker: Sandeep
signals.sentence: The prior authorization example has been converted into a digital prior authorization product launched under the Optum Real family of products.

signals.speaker: Sandeep
signals.sentence: This internal use case is being converted into a commercial product to improve the system for everyone.

signals.speaker: Bobby
signals.sentence: As we navigate the next few months, our approach is to continue partnering with CMS to identify solutions that ensure program stability, clarity for the industry, and the best outcomes for beneficiaries.

signals.speaker: Bobby
signals.sentence: All that said, we remain fully committed to our quality agenda and will continue investing in quality in the second half of the year to support members and providers.

signals.speaker: Krista
signals.sentence: Timing of restructuring efforts shifted; we had planned for significant restructuring to complete in the first half, but one significant item is shifting into the second half, which affects the second half versus first half cadence.

signals.speaker: Krista
signals.sentence: Second, we are investing in the business as we launch new clinical and operational initiatives and invest in technology workflow enhancements to scale and make them durable across infrastructure.

signals.speaker: Krista
signals.sentence: While medical performance moderated a bit in the first half and performed slightly better than expected, trends are still well above historical levels, and we're being cautious.

signals.speaker: Wayne DeVeydt
signals.sentence: I don't expect a material change; our adjustment is meant to show what real durable earnings are.
